name: Anime4up
description: Anime4up module with title-matched covers, resilient Arabic episode parsing, decoded UQLoad JWPlayer/HLS sources, and Share4Max mirror resolution prioritised for direct playback. beta.9 accepts every Share4Max payload shape (paginator and plain array), falls back to the page-embedded Inertia payload when the partial request is not JSON, reads mirror rows from mirrors/sources/links and link/url/src, and bounds the Share4Max phase to 9s so it cannot spend the whole episode budget.
